findings.issue: The 23 microsecond example described the extra 6 microseconds as per plan even though its arithmetic requires a per-call cost.
findings.discovered_by: Author secondary review during combined example verification; independently recomputed and corrected by root.
findings.repair: Changed frequency to per invocation; preserved distinction between one plan and repeated calls.
findings.counterexample: If 6 microseconds occurs per plan, the average over 32 calls is 17.1875, not 23 microseconds.

findings.section: 一个慢客户端的容量算例
findings.original_issue: Remote client consumption rate was used directly as the outflow of an intermediate engine/transport queue; downstream buffers can absorb data before backpressure reaches that queue.
findings.requested_change: State the measured/assumed arrival and departure rates of the same bounded queue; distinguish remote consumption and downstream buffered bytes.
findings.resolution: Root changed the example to actual local enqueue 8000 B/s and dequeue 2000 B/s, and added buffering/backpressure scope. Reviewer reread the changed section.
evidence: ASGI Response Body only guarantees delivery to server send buffer, not remote consumption.
Queue conservation applies to rates at the same queue boundary.

findings.section: 将接收、完成、提交和释放分别表达
findings.original_issue: The blanket claim about an ASGI send return flushing data to the server send buffer is too broad. Response Start is explicitly allowed to defer this flush; the guarantee is in Response Body.
findings.requested_change: Bind the claim to successful http.response.body handling and distinguish http.response.start; preserve the statement that remote consumption is not confirmed.

evidence.meaning: Response Start need not flush until first Response Body.
Response Body must flush body data to send buffer before send returns.

findings.resolution: Root narrowed the flush guarantee to successful http.response.body send handling and explicitly distinguished http.response.start. Reviewer reread the full revised chapter and fixed-source lines 179-245; the text now matches the source and does not imply remote consumption.

findings.heading: 用可区分实验选择同步、重叠或减少搬运
findings.current_text: 测量窗口须包含管线排空
findings.issue: 将有限批完成时间和稳态吞吐窗口合并为一个强制口径。有限批计时必须直到最后批完成；持续服务的稳态窗口可以与停止接入后的排空分开，但须定义窗口和在途请求的归属、追踪结局。当前绝对表述容易把稳态与有限 workload 的指标混用，也与 service-protocol 对稳态窗/排空的区分不一致。
findings.suggested_fix: 改为：有限批完成时间应计至最后一批完成；稳态吞吐应单列稳态测量窗口，并报告窗口边界的在途请求及窗口后结局。主机提交结束不能代替完成，排空时间另行报告。
findings.basis: 由章节自身 T_N 与 P_0 的不同指标定义及请求结局记账推导，不依赖 GPU 测量。
findings.resolution: 已分别定义有限任务完成时间包含排空、明确稳态窗口及窗口两端在途工作/计数口径/窗口后结局；不再强制将稳态窗与排空混为一个口径。

findings.heading: 成本模型要从实际不能隐藏的路径计算
findings.current_text: 单向有效链路带宽为 B；接收流量不能再乘入时间项。
findings.issue: 理想 ring 公式和数值正确；建议显式说明发送与接收方向可同时工作，B 是单向可持续带宽而不是双向共享总带宽。若方向竞争同一资源，需要重新合计该共享资源流量。
findings.suggested_fix: 在公式假设中加入“收发方向可并发，B 不是双向流量合计带宽”；在解释接收流量处补共享链路或半双工要单独建模。
findings.basis: 带宽单位及资源服务时间模型的适用范围；属于假设精化，不是当前理想模型下的计算错误。
findings.resolution: 已显式限定全双工、发送与接收可并发、B 是单向有效带宽；原公式与计算在此假设下成立。

findings.issue: Original text conflated fixed-budget failure and right-censored time-to-success observations.
findings.counterexample: An irreversibly crashed construction run cannot be treated as an ordinary still-at-risk run merely censored at a deadline. Doing so can bias time-to-success and hide delivery failure.
findings.repair: All non-deliveries remain unsuccessful for fixed-budget completion rate. Administrative right censoring is limited to runs still able to finish, stopped only by a predeclared common time window. Crash/irreversible failure and other resource-budget stops require distinct handling.
findings.repair_review: Reread the entire paragraph and surrounding experiment design. The restrictions are sufficient for this methodological text; no particular survival estimator is claimed to be validated.

findings.issue: Original text allowed fewer useless experiments to support lower construction cost without a cost measurement.
findings.counterexample: Old: 10 experiments at unit cost = 10. New: 5 experiments at cost 3 = 15. Count falls while total cost rises.
findings.repair: Cost improvement now requires measured reduction in total cost or cost to a qualified system under the same acceptance standard; experiment count alone is explicitly insufficient.
findings.repair_review: Reread against the adjacent fixed-budget success and selection-scope cautions; the new statement supports a scoped cost conclusion and preserves success/resource tradeoffs.

findings.issue: Original success-denominator phrasing could be interpreted as removing blocked later turns/sessions from the denominator.
findings.counterexample: A multi-turn session fails on the first dependency; deleting all blocked follow-ups or the session can report a successful observed subset while the planned session failed.
findings.repair: Blocked turns cannot count as verified success, and the predefined session population cannot drop the session. Planned logical turns and actual issued requests are separate; per-request denominators must be predefined; session success requires all necessary dependencies.
findings.repair_review: The revised paragraph cleanly separates request-conditional metrics from whole-session success. Sentence flow is coherent.

findings.issue: The table can be read as finite local checks proving a component contract throughout an entire declared input domain.
findings.counterexample: Passing selected lengths/shapes does not establish all lengths/shapes or all valid state transitions without proof/exhaustive coverage.
findings.recommendation: Replace the supported conclusion with evidence-scoped wording such as 已检查的输入/性质及证据范围内满足组件契约, or explicitly condition the whole-domain conclusion on a proof or exhaustive argument.
findings.repair: Author changed the supported conclusion to 已检查的输入、性质及证据范围内满足组件契约.
findings.repair_review: The complete new 91-line chapter was reread after the hash changed. Wording now binds the local conclusion to inspected input/properties and evidence scope; this advisory is closed.
